data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin that displays an Apple Maps widget on iOS.
data.what_it_does: The plugin provides an AppleMap widget using Flutter platform views to render Apple Maps inside a Flutter application. It supports camera controls, annotations, circles, polygons, polylines, and taking snapshots of the map.
use_when: You are building an iOS app in Flutter and specifically want to use Apple Maps.
You need standard map features like annotations, overlays, and camera movement controls on iOS.
avoid_when: You need cross-platform map support including Android within the same plugin directly (requires combining with another plugin).
You prefer a purely Flutter-rendered map solution rather than a platform view.
strengths: Native Apple Maps integration for iOS
Supports map annotations, polylines, polygons, and circles
Provides camera control methods like moveCamera and animateCamera
weaknesses: Relies on platform views, which have historically been in preview
data.setup_notes: Opt-in for embedded views preview in Info.plist (`io.flutter.embedded_views_preview` set to `YES`) and add location permission usage descriptions if needed.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need cross-platform map support using Google Maps.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a pure Dart-rendered map solution that works seamlessly across all platforms using tile servers like OpenStreetMap.
